name: memory_search
description: Search Droi Memory (the Memory Summary, the Session Summaries of earlier Sessions and the Memory Notes) for words, when the Memory Summary does not point you to what you need. Answers matching lines as file:line.

query.description: One to three specific words; lines holding all of them come first. Quote a phrase to keep it whole.

name: memory_read
description: Read one Memory file: a Session Summary the Memory Summary points to (session_summaries/...), a Memory Note (notes/...) or memory_summary.md. Lines are numbered.

path.description: The file's path in Memory, such as session_summaries/2026-10-27T09-21-03-1a2b3c4d-fix-login.md.

name: memory_list
description: List Memory's files: the Session Summaries newest first, with their day, Workspace and title, and the Memory Notes.

workspace.description: Only Session Summaries whose Workspace path contains this.

name: memory_note
description: Only when the user explicitly asks you to remember, forget or correct something for later Sessions: save what they asked as a Memory Note. Droi folds it into the Memory Summary, where it wins over older memory. Do not call it for things you learned on your own; Droi summarizes finished Sessions by itself. Never include secrets.

text.description: What the user asked, in their language, standing on its own: "The user asked to remember: ...", "The user asked to forget: ..." or "The user corrected: ...".
